files.description: Project scripts and dependency surface. `glados` is the primary quality gate: Biome check, TypeScript check, and production build.
Global OzmahDev token foundation: Tailwind v4 theme tokens, colors, typography aliases, spacing, focus, motion, button component classes, and global base styles.
Custom button primitive. Supports primary, secondary, and tertiary variants with accessible focus state and disabled handling. Hero CTA audio should be opt-in, not global button behavior.
Internal component lab / visual torture room. Used before building real pages to expose spacing, sizing, focus, responsive, and context-dependency problems.
